episodes.title: Final forecast vintages used before they existed
episodes.question: Does the apparent wind-forecast-surprise edge justify production use, or must the research dataset be repaired first?
episodes.briefing: The strategy acts at 07:00 UTC using a vendor forecast. An audit-ready decision must cover provenance, data integrity, chronological validation, uncertainty, and cost or regime stress. Complete all five audit gates before submitting the memo.

inspect_market_context.interpretation: The archive can contain revisions published after the trading decision.

run_data_quality_checks.deterministic_verdict: The feature uses final forecast vintages that were unavailable at decision time, creating target-adjacent leakage.

run_walk_forward_validation.deterministic_verdict: The apparent uplift disappears when each row uses the forecast vintage available at the decision time.

run_statistical_inference.estimator: Newey-West HAC differential on as-issued vintages
run_statistical_inference.deterministic_verdict: Corrected data do not establish a reliable positive effect.

run_strategy_stress_test.deterministic_verdict: Operational timing and cost stresses make the corrected result negative.

episodes.title: UTC load joined to local-time prices
episodes.question: Is the cross-market load-price signal robust, or is a timestamp alignment defect driving the apparent relationship?
episodes.briefing: A GB load series and a German price series were joined on timestamp strings. An audit-ready decision must cover provenance, data integrity, chronological validation, uncertainty, and cost or regime stress. Complete all five audit gates before submitting the memo.

inspect_market_context.interpretation: The same clock label refers to different instants for most of the year.

run_data_quality_checks.deterministic_verdict: The join confuses UTC with local civil time and changes lag at daylight-saving boundaries.

run_walk_forward_validation.deterministic_verdict: Most apparent value vanishes after both feeds are normalized to UTC before joining.

run_strategy_stress_test.deterministic_verdict: The strategy is especially fragile exactly where the timestamp defect changes.

episodes.title: A relationship that ends after a bidding-zone split
episodes.question: Does the historical congestion predictor support a current Austrian power-market recommendation?
episodes.briefing: The sample spans the 2018 separation of the German-Austrian bidding zone. An audit-ready decision must cover provenance, data integrity, chronological validation, uncertainty, and cost or regime stress. Complete all five audit gates before submitting the memo.

inspect_market_context.interpretation: A known market-design change sits inside the estimation sample.

run_data_quality_checks.deterministic_verdict: Rows are technically clean, but the target process has a material structural break at the zone split.

run_walk_forward_validation.deterministic_verdict: A pooled gain is carried by an obsolete pre-split regime and reverses in every recent fold.

run_statistical_inference.deterministic_verdict: The post-split effect is negative and statistically different from the pre-split effect.

run_strategy_stress_test.deterministic_verdict: Current-market and cost stresses do not recover the obsolete relationship.

episodes.title: Missing outage notices during scarcity events
episodes.question: Does the outage-news feature provide a robust Nordic balancing-market edge?
episodes.briefing: The research table includes only intervals with successfully parsed outage notices. An audit-ready decision must cover provenance, data integrity, chronological validation, uncertainty, and cost or regime stress. Complete all five audit gates before submitting the memo.

inspect_market_context.row_policy: drop interval when notice parser returns no record
inspect_market_context.interpretation: Parser coverage determines which target intervals remain in the research sample.

run_data_quality_checks.deterministic_verdict: Missing notice rows are not random; coverage is worst during the scarcity outcomes the strategy targets.

run_walk_forward_validation.deterministic_verdict: The complete-case uplift disappears under two prespecified treatments of coverage failure.

run_statistical_inference.deterministic_verdict: Selection-adjusted inference does not establish an edge.

run_strategy_stress_test.deterministic_verdict: Performance is negative in the high-value scarcity regime and under plausible operations.

episodes.title: Reserve activation values switch from MW to GW
episodes.question: Is the reserve-volume discontinuity a real market shift that can drive a strategy, or does the dataset require repair?
episodes.briefing: The feature name and database schema say MW throughout. An audit-ready decision must cover provenance, data integrity, chronological validation, uncertainty, and cost or regime stress. Complete all five audit gates before submitting the memo.

inspect_market_context.interpretation: A source version change coincides exactly with the numeric discontinuity.

run_data_quality_checks.deterministic_verdict: The new API emits GW while the stored field remains labelled MW; the affected segment needs a 1,000-fold conversion.

run_walk_forward_validation.deterministic_verdict: The apparent strategy value is largely the model exploiting the scale boundary.

run_statistical_inference.deterministic_verdict: The corrected feature does not establish a reliable positive effect.

run_strategy_stress_test.deterministic_verdict: No plausible corrected stress recovers the uncorrected uplift.

episodes.title: Solar residual signal reverses in curtailment regimes
episodes.question: Does the solar-residual feature support a robust day-ahead trading recommendation after temporal, statistical, and cost checks?
episodes.briefing: Basic preprocessing is complete, but the candidate may behave differently during negative-price curtailment. An audit-ready decision must cover provenance, data integrity, chronological validation, uncertainty, and cost or regime stress. Complete all five audit gates before submitting the memo.

inspect_market_context.decision_metric: net value after spread and imbalance costs

run_data_quality_checks.deterministic_verdict: The dataset passes the prespecified integrity checks.

run_walk_forward_validation.deterministic_verdict: Small pooled value hides a reversal in the curtailment regime and instability across folds.

run_statistical_inference.deterministic_verdict: The pooled effect is uncertain and differs materially by curtailment regime.

run_strategy_stress_test.deterministic_verdict: Plausible cost and curtailment stresses turn the small pooled result negative.

episodes.title: The repeated autumn hour inflates an imbalance feature
episodes.question: Can the local-time imbalance panel be used unchanged for the proposed intraday strategy?
episodes.briefing: The panel contains several autumn clock changes and is keyed by naive local hour. An audit-ready decision must cover provenance, data integrity, chronological validation, uncertainty, and cost or regime stress. Complete all five audit gates before submitting the memo.

inspect_market_context.interpretation: Every autumn transition contains two distinct delivery periods labelled 02:00.

run_data_quality_checks.deterministic_verdict: Naive local time is not a unique delivery-period key; retain offsets or normalize to UTC.

run_walk_forward_validation.deterministic_verdict: The apparent uplift disappears when repeated local hours are represented as distinct UTC intervals.

run_statistical_inference.deterministic_verdict: The corrected panel provides no reliable positive effect.

run_strategy_stress_test.deterministic_verdict: The strategy fails in the transition periods that created the original artefact.

episodes.title: Promising cross-border signal with too little prospective evidence
episodes.question: Should the cross-border-flow anomaly be rejected, deployed, or retained only as a provisional research signal?
episodes.briefing: The feature was defined before the latest holdout, but only a short post-change sample is available. An audit-ready decision must cover provenance, data integrity, chronological validation, uncertainty, and cost or regime stress. Complete all five audit gates before submitting the memo.

run_data_quality_checks.deterministic_verdict: No prespecified integrity or leakage failure was found.

run_walk_forward_validation.deterministic_verdict: The frozen feature is positive prospectively, but the holdout contains only two months and 19 events.

run_statistical_inference.deterministic_verdict: The direction is promising, but the current interval includes zero and the study is underpowered.

run_strategy_stress_test.deterministic_verdict: The signal survives higher costs but not the limited outage scenario; more prospective regimes are required.
